node.title: Re^3: Reading a hash structure stored in a file
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
I wonder if there are other useful modules that are now core but have been omitted from the documentation.

[mod://HTTP::Tiny] is another one. [http://perldoc.perl.org] is also still stuck on 5.26.1 as the highest version...

At the moment I'm not even sure where the current repo for the site is. [https://github.com/jonallen/perldoc.perl.org] and [https://github.com/perlorg/perldoc.perl.org] both had their last commits in 2016.
